description: External control of the quality of construction, listed by ZAG under its external control work for DARS (1998 to 2014). The list covers thirteen motorway tunnels and the repair works in the Karavanke motorway and railway tunnels. ZAG does not give dates for each tunnel.

source_differences: Lengths: 595 m north and 609 m south (Structurae) against 615 m and 602 m (Lotsberg, with artificial parts of 258 m and 241 m). The mapped geometry measures 618 m and 605 m.
Opening date: 30 May 2008 (Lotsberg) against 30 October 2008 for the section Spodnja Senarska to Vučja vas (RTV SLO), which does not name the tunnel.
Tunnel length: 360 m bored + 230 m covered cut = 590 m (2005 location plan) (tax-fin-lex.si) against 595 and 609 m (Structurae), 615 and 602 m (Lotsberg) (structurae.net)
